task_title: Deterministic controls for the top-5 regression classes

plan_review.notes: Adversarial separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.6-sol) against the implementation. 6 concerns. FIXED: (1) allowlist registration keyed on bare export name, so a new `export const ALLOWLIST` in any file rode on the orphaned-systems registration - now keyed file#name with an anti-bypass negative-control test; (2) asset-integrity collapsed an unreadable-but-existing PNG to undefined hash, silently accepting it - now emits a finding; (3) merge-scope.sh fell back to local main while silent-reverts.ts defaults to origin/main, so an offline clone reported can_run=true then died - now emits base_ref and verify-fast forwards it as SILENT_REVERT_BASE_REF; (4) merge-scope treated a git rev-list FAILURE as no-merges - now can_run=false. ACCEPTED AS DOCUMENTED RESIDUAL RISK: (5) ESLint rule recall gap (helper-called-from-loop, Promise.all(map)) - deliberate precision-over-recall trade to avoid a class-C guard, recorded in ADR Risks with forEachSafe wrapper as the named follow-up; (6) registry check is an ID-integrity slice, not all of class D - ADR reworded to say so explicitly and schema-derived fixtures named as the top follow-up. Also noted: a persistently failing oldest PR still blocks FIFO admission by design (the break is intentional ordering); pre-existing behaviour, strictly improved by removing the process crash, logged as follow-up.
